_doc: Sweep 2a amendment (T, 2026-11-20 evening): web news and questions about the Librarian itself, General mode, a real search provider. Run with scripts/librarian/web_bench.sh (reads the live-harness test key from the Keychain; never written). Graded by scripts/librarian/web_grade.py from results.json + the web trace: news answers must name actual stories (not outlets or sections), a turn that searched must never say it can't search, and a question about the Librarian itself must not be sent to search.
